hypothesis.counterhypothesis: The projection stage may intentionally be thin because a retained upstream verifier guarantees every input; in that architecture local recomputation would duplicate authority and add complexity.
hypothesis.discriminator: Resolve and bind the single retained upstream materialization verifier. Prove it recomputes exact ABI-manifest membership, tokenizer token IDs, symbol partition, counterbalance and receipt hashes; then demonstrate the projection stage consumes only receipts from that verifier. If no such reachable verifier exists, v1 is not fail-closed for untrusted/materialized input.
hypothesis.primary: The Qwen3.5-0.8B specialization should explicitly learn a VERIFY_BEFORE_PROJECT invariant: model-visible training projection is downstream of exact materialization evidence and must not treat hash-shaped strings, booleans, IDs, or self-minted receipts as proof.

new_source_observations.finding: The v1 projection gate validates four evidence identities only as 64-hex strings; it does not recompute the digests over referenced artifacts.

The v1 projection gate consumes *_verified booleans as input assertions and does not independently derive tokenizer single-token status, symbol-partition visibility, real-atom counterbalance, or rejected-atom exclusion.

The v1 projection gate checks only triplet injectivity, target membership in that triplet, and literal exclusion of 'or'; it does not load the exact 46-atom ABI manifest to prove accepted-atom membership.

The current unit test intentionally expects PASS with arbitrary atom strings xu/ze/qi and every required hash set to the same synthetic 64-character value. This confirms that v1 is a projection/visibility guard rather than an independent materialization verifier.
The tool explicitly returns canonical_dataset_admission=false, accepted_dataset_tokens_minted=0, and training_credit_minted=false, preserving a correct no-credit boundary even on projection PASS.

next_exact_action: Discover the retained exact materialization verifier/receipt producer, or implement one only after its canonical ABI/tokenizer/partition receipt schemas are resolved. Then run it on a small real 46-atom sample, cross-bind the resulting receipt into projection v1/v2, and only afterward attempt Forge->Distillery positive-yield admission.

research_return.architecture_implication: Preserve exactly one upstream materialization-evidence authority and keep the projection tool a pure visibility/filter boundary. Do not let projection receipts recursively authenticate their own unchecked inputs.
research_return.harness_implication_for_future_go: A future Xeno harness/trainer should bind row -> generator -> exact ABI manifest bytes -> atom membership -> exact tokenizer identity/token IDs -> split-symbol manifest -> materialization receipt -> projection -> Forge/Distillery admission -> training/checkpoint evaluation as separate, inspectable links.

swarm_review.result: Reviewed exact current v1 gate source and its tests; separated visibility behavior from upstream materialization verification.
Hash-shape fields and self-declared verification booleans can satisfy v1 without the gate independently observing the referenced manifest/tokenizer/partition/receipt bytes.
Arbitrary distinct symbols other than literal 'or' can pass the local triplet predicate; exact 46-atom membership is not established here.
Nonempty counterfactual_family_id and a partition hash claim do not establish realized family topology or split-symbol disjointness; those remain upstream/family-level obligations.
v1 correctly refuses canonical dataset/training credit; the discovered gap concerns evidence authentication before model-visible projection, not credit inflation inside the tool.
Nine new families are confined to one split each; provenance ancestry IDs do not cross splits; holdout rows were authored as separate families and were not used to tune train answers.
Keep the 18-row seed as candidate supervision for evidence-chain reasoning. Do not materialize accepted tokens from it until canonical admission.

validation.reason: This cycle used connected GitHub source inspection and deterministic local JSON/schema checks; no admitted EntityOS/HCU runtime execution was performed.
